description: Run a free tool from the Vybe Marketplace and get its answer. No sign-in or spend key needed, and nothing is charged. Get the slug, action names and inputs from search_tools or get_tool first. Free tools have fair-use limits per caller; if you hit one, tell the user when it resets. Paid tools can't run here: use pay_offering and use_paid_offering. Related: search_tools, get_tool.

inputSchema.description: slug is required. Pass toolName when the tool has more than one action.

slug.description: Tool slug from search_tools or get_tool.

toolArguments.description: The action's inputs as JSON, using the keys from get_tool.

toolName.description: Action name from get_tool. Optional when the tool has one action.

inputSchema.title: RunFreeToolInput

name: run_free_tool

outputSchema.description: The tool's answer, or why it couldn't run.
outputSchema.title: RunFreeToolResult

title: Run free marketplace tool
